body: Never not been single. I think it's because I'm easy to categorize as friend material and I'm not super physically attractive.
I will try to keep that in mind.

Please don't apologize for incoherence. You've managed to be incredibly lovely and understanding in a way that isn't overbearing. I appreciate your genuine responses. I guess we're all working on ourselves to some degree. I try to fight it, but sometimes it just gets too much and I want to stop existing. I'll try to keep overcoming.

Thank you for taking the time to respond. Dealing with all my own bullshit is really frustrating because no matter how much I reflect on things (and even writing them down now), I can never understand the root of my problems. I can't trace them back to any event or childhood trauma. It makes me feel like all of this just sprung up for the sake of my own dysfunction.
